_about: D-45 subtitle depth (Art/字幕方案_D-45.md C.2; seat_occlusion.py --subtitle-depth). depth[seat][yaw][pitch] in metres = clamp(0.92 x d_near, 0.45, 1.0); d_near = the nearest hit of any opaque part that is the first hit for >= 10 % of the cell's 1-degree rays (glass passes, except opaque_glass); 1.0 where no part qualifies. Full, uneroded bus, door open, the current Bus/Source build. Seat order = BusLayout.json seats = SetSeat index; hero = 0. Yaw 0 = forward, + = right (door side); pitch + = up.
cells: yaw cell j: centre yaw0 + yaw_step * j (covers +-7.5 deg); pitch cell i: centre pitch0 + pitch_step * i (covers +-5 deg)
runtime: take the minimum of the cell and its two yaw neighbours (no interpolation)
